column1: # box-link-watch topics - which topic owns the work of each relay box
# (do_spl_box_link_watch, SPL-4816). The watcher sends a stuck link to that
# topic's live seat (lane map), else to the dispatch lease holder.
# box = the dir under BOX_LINK_WATCH_ROOT on the hub; topic = its first 8 hex;
# workspace = the topic's workspace (SPL-4880): a seat or fallback on another
# machine is reached through that workspace's desk only, never the lease's;
# a row without it sends nothing to another machine.
